scope: one synthetic B3.1 local inference under unprivileged Windows TCP connection observation

process_observation.method: Get-NetTCPConnection sampled by process ID for the CLI process tree
process_observation.pktmon_capture: unavailable: access denied without Administrator privileges

limitations: The observation saw only active TCP connections at sampled instants; it is not a full packet capture or proof that no short-lived or failed connection attempt occurred.
Only five snapshots were obtained and actual polling cadence was not measured; host process working set does not measure or cap GPU VRAM.
UDP and other network activity are not covered by this observation.
No operating-system network isolation or firewall egress block was enabled.
The assessor is Qwen, not TypeSafe Jev; its labels are uncalibrated and are not BTC return probabilities or trading signals.
